boundaries: The archive reads JavaScript as bytes and text. It never require(), import(), eval(), parse-executes, installs, or starts an archived organ.
Part-card descriptions, tags, interface roles, parameters, authority markers, and metrics are static observations or labelled inferences, not proof that the organ behaves as described.
A matching input/output schema literal is future drag-and-drop routing evidence only. It does not prove runtime compatibility, safety, permission, readiness, or quality.

A normal persistent Mirror runtime automatically owns the lightweight archive watcher lifecycle. Starting Mirror performs a catch-up scan and watches later organ changes; stopping Mirror stops it. Outside Mirror, the scan and watcher still require explicit invocation.
Automatic archive capture never loads, starts, installs, admits, promotes, or grants authority to an archived organ.
The verification organ is separate from automatic archive capture. Only an explicit local call may start exact direct public Node test witnesses, and it seals both passing and failing output.
The test process uses a reduced environment but is not sandboxed; test code retains the local OS permissions of that process. No automatic verification is claimed.

A PASS overlay means only that the exact current organ and direct test bytes passed the recorded process. It does not prove universal behavior, compatibility, safety, quality, permission, runtime admission, or CANON.
Workshop Verification Spine intake is explicit and read-only toward the Workshop. Mirror parses data files only and never loads or executes the Workshop verifier implementation.

An accepted external report means Mirror independently reproduced its categories, contradictions, holds, warnings and verdict from embedded receipts plus the bound profile. The report itself may honestly be FAILED, HELD, HUMAN_REVIEW or VERIFIED_WITH_LIMITS.
External categories remain separate and contradictions remain holds. They are never averaged into an intelligence, quality, compatibility, safety or readiness score.

An external category receipt appears on an archived organ version only when its subject kind is organ or ai-organ and its subject digest exactly matches that source version. Even then, external PASS grants no admission, permission, training, promotion, CANON or world authority.
Archive admission does not imply test passage, review, promotion, CANON, identity membership, or runtime availability.

A specialist Mirror is an isolated archived-public-body configuration lineage with its own private state namespace. It does not inherit Mirror private memory or checkpoints and has no write or automatic return path into Mirror.

A v2 specialist generation ID binds its composition algorithm and exact generation, component, projection, graph, and dependency-closure protocol versions. Earlier generations remain immutable evidence when a protocol changes.
Specialist composition search ranks static metadata fit for an isolated exam. It does not prove intelligence, behavior, compatibility, optimization, or runtime readiness.
Hands and modules remain unresolved assembly needs until equally typed catalogs exist; the incubator does not invent dependencies from names.
A dormant organ component is a static data projection about exact archived executable bytes, not the executable organ itself and not a hand, agent, permission, runtime body, or admission decision.
Only exact declared schema literals become input or output hints. Unclassified literals and filename-derived tags remain non-routing advisory evidence.

Only exact current catalog source-path resolution creates a local-organ dependency edge. Missing selected dependencies, absent catalog organs, escaped paths, cycles, and ambiguous schema providers remain typed holds.
Literal schema equality creates a proposed static edge only. It never proves behavioral compatibility and never connects components automatically.
Inputs without providers and outputs without consumers remain separate visible routing gaps. An unconsumed output is not automatically called incompatible, and it is never connected by guesswork.

Workshop worlds, physics substrates, Holodeck tools, and other cross-root or non-*-organ.js artifacts are not Mirror AI organs. Paths, names, and matching world schema literals grant no import, execution, connection, or world-action authority.
Static source bytes are measured; CPU, GPU, peak memory, working storage, and native runtime remain UNKNOWN_NOT_MEASURED.
Content-addressed projection replay creates no new writes, but neither a new nor reused projection grants execution, connection, permission, runtime admission, promotion, CANON, or world authority.

Purpose classifications are deterministic inferences from public static metadata. One primary category is only a browsing shelf; multiple use fields and functional roles may coexist, and no label proves semantic fitness, compatibility, safety, quality, permission, or readiness.

Portable export is explicit and copies only current public organ source plus bounded static metadata into a content-addressed share package. It excludes private state, specialist memory, checkpoints, historical organ versions, archive receipts, raw verification output, logs, tokens, and secrets.

A receiving model may read the portable library as review material but must not execute, connect, install, admit, train on, promote, or canonize an organ merely because it appears in a category or export.
